effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

corroboration.title: UDE official Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Rulings (capture 2005-06-16, inside the GOAT window)
corroboration.quote: You must show your opponent the monster you select from your Deck for this card's effect. If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck Card Rulings, compiled April 6th 2010 (18 days before the Edison snapshot)
corroboration.quote: If you do not have "Commander Covington" in your Deck, your opponent can ask to verify.

corroboration.title: Konami, Storm of Ragnarok Card Rulings, compiled February 2 2011 - the latest positive attestation of the old state
corroboration.quote: If there is no longer a monster in your hand that you can Special Summon when this effect resolves, your opponent may briefly verify that this is the case.

transitions.historical_text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV1", as long as this card remains face-up on the field, decrease the ATK of all your opponent's monsters by 300 points. During your Standby Phase, send this face-up card to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV5" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)
transitions.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: after this card is sent to the Graveyard as the cost, if no "Ultimate Insect LV5" can be Special Summoned, the goat script proves the whiff by revealing BOTH hand and Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. The printed text is untouched by this.

transitions.historical_text: If this card was Special Summoned by the effect of "Ultimate Insect LV1", as long as this card remains face-up on the field, decrease the ATK of all your opponent's monsters by 300 points. During your Standby Phase, send this face-up card to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Ultimate Insect LV5" from your hand or Deck. (You cannot activate this effect the turn this card is Normal Summoned, Special Summoned, or flipped face-up.)
transitions.summary: Separate per-card ruling: the goat script's activation check keeps only the free-zone test ('if chk==0 then return ft>0 end'), dropping the modern requirement that a Special Summonable "Ultimate Insect LV5" be in the hand or Deck, so the player may pay the cost with nothing to Summon. Nothing in the packet dates when this allowance ended, so the chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline implements lineage v0 (RDS-EN007, 2004-12-01, exact cdb match); trailing v0 -> v1 (DR3-EN067, 2006-11-25) is cosmetic ('decrease the ATK of all your opponent's monsters by 300 points' -> 'all of your opponent's monsters lose 300 ATK', 'as long as this card remains face-up on the field' -> 'while it remains on the field', cost rewording) and the continuous ATK effect is untouched in the diff. The remaining diff lines are legacy-syntax or variant plumbing with no behavioural content: EVENT_PHASE+PHASE_STANDBY, LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK, additive RESET flags, raw 0x5d for SET_ULTIMATE_INSECT, GetFlagEffect(MODID) for the LV1 summon marker, and an inline s.spcost equivalent to Cost.SelfToGrave. Reveal and relaxed cost/activation are entangled in play but recorded separately because only the reveal has sourced bounds; the state between them needs no implementation, as GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
